column2: the plan adds gantt-preservation wording to anti-halt, step 5c item 5, and step 5d, but not to the cancellation-run handoff at `skills/design/skill.md:319-321` (`### final summary block` post-notification prose). cancelled `/design` runs still emit `design-step-final-summary.sh` output through the marker-first profile on that path. without the explicit “verbatim means the entire marker body” / gantt-preservation reminder there, the model can keep omitting `### round n reviewer timing` blocks on cancellation paths.

the plan’s new wording covers step 5c item 5 and step 5d, but not the earlier `_publish_rc` abort emission at `skills/design/skill.md:840-842` (failed-publish-tail stop). a step 5c run that exits through that abort path still publishes a final-summary body before termination. that path can remain shortened because the inline gantt-preservation rule never reaches the abort emission site.

the gantt-preservation harness can pass via file-wide `grep` and a global occurrence count (e.g. ≥ 5) instead of verifying prose at each of the five marker-first emit bindings. an implementer can stack gantt-preservation bullets at abort/cancellation/anti-halt (or other wrong paragraphs) while the approved-path step 5c item 5 emit, the `### final summary block` cancellation binding, and other real handoff sites stay unchanged. ci passes; approved `/design` runs can still omit `### round n reviewer timing` blocks — the #5408 regression the plan targets.

scripts/test-render-cost-line-callsites.sh:53-59 [scope-reduction] cancellation harness allows a weak global-count-only branch. scenario: the plan’s cancellation pin offers an `e.g.` path of separate greps plus `global gantt prose count ≥ 5` as an alternative to a positional scan. an implementer can satisfy ci by sprinkling five copies anywhere in `skills/design/skill.md` while leaving the `### final summary block` handoff without adjacent gantt-preservation prose; cancelled runs would still truncate timing tables.

the new per-callsite scan is paragraph-loose and uses a fixed forward window, so gantt-preservation checks can pass without updating the intended binding paragraph. the cancellation check can pass if the new sentence lands on sibling-contract text (for example `skills/design/skill.md:321`), or the step 5c check can pass if it lands in nearby item 6/7 prose, while the real callsite stays unchanged. worse, adjacent step 5c abort and item 5 anchors sit two lines apart but the harness uses an 8-line forward window, so either site can false-pass using the other site's gantt bullets: gantt-preservation lines appended only at item 5 (lines 843–845) still satisfy the abort-window checks, and prose inserted only into the abort paragraph on line 840 still satisfies the item-5 window. ci passes while the approved-path item 5 handoff that regressed in #5408 stays without adjacent inline gantt-preservation text, so the bug can recur despite green harness.
